uncited: It builds on the [VCP Ray-Casting Algorithm](10664-vcp-ray-casting-algorithm.md) by adding specific mechanisms for handling ray termination and depth buffer synchronization within the GPU pipeline.
The method uses a loop of traversal and z-update passes to advance rays through the volume data.
It relies on a specific cell index value to manage state and termination.
*   **Current Cell Index:** An integer value associated with each ray/fragment.
*   **Depth Buffer:** Stores depth values to facilitate early z-testing.
*   **Color Buffer:** Stores the accumulated color for each ray.
**Initialize:** Set up the first traversal pass.
*   For each fragment (ray), determine the current cell index.
*   Perform a z-update pass to update the depth buffer.
*   Check if any pixels are still set (active).
**Repeat:** Continue the loop of traversal and z-update passes until the termination condition is met.
*   **Asynchronous Stalls:** Waiting for occlusion query results can cause pipeline stalls.
